one_liner: Senior GS-15 analyst in USPTO's CFO office leading financial-management performance studies, data analytics, process governance and briefings for top leadership.
fit_summary: This GS-15 role requires a year at GS-14 level in financial-management decision support, large cross-functional projects and analytics briefings for senior leaders. Daniel's analysis work (Excel spending reports, FEMA onboarding data) is at a much smaller scale, so skip it.
eligibility: Open to the public (U.S. citizens) and the fed-transition path, so no prior federal status is required.
One full year (52 weeks) of specialized experience equivalent to GS-14 in financial-management operational research/decision support, large-project management, and data management/analytics.
Education cannot substitute for experience at this grade.
Must pass the USA Hire assessment cut score across competencies like Reasoning, Decision Making, and Interpersonal Skills.
Clearance listed as 'Other' (likely a background investigation); on-site presence in Alexandria required with only 52 telework hours per year.
strategy: Skip this one: his resume shows no senior financial or analytics leadership.
GS-9 to GS-12 management and program analyst roles fit his background better.
resume_bullets: Built Excel pivot-table reports on spending and order status for multi-state COVID-19 operations (2021–2022).
Completed Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt training.
interview_questions: Describe a time you used data analysis to change a senior leader's decision on a financial or program issue.
How have you managed a large, cross-functional project to establish new policies or governance standards?
Walk us through how you would build an enterprise-wide process improvement program for financial management.
How do you tailor complex financial or analytical information for executive audiences?
watch_outs: The GS-15 specialized-experience bar is very high and education can't substitute, so Daniel is likely not to qualify.
The role is heavily on-site, with only 52 telework hours per year, which means commuting from Manassas to Alexandria.
USA Hire has a hard cut score, so failing or skipping it ends your consideration.
